clue.text: Leave off part of the air

definitions.meaning: to stop or hold back from doing something
a recurring section of a song or tune, the chorus

explanation.surface: Someone is told to omit a section of a melody.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means abstain or desist; as a noun it is the repeated chorus of a song, an air being a tune.

clue.text: Insect, at the end, is smaller than usual

parts.note: a midge is a tiny biting fly

indicators.note: the closing letter of the word 'at' is taken

explanation.surface: A remark that some bug is undersized.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Insect' gives MIDGE; 'at the end' tells you to take the final letter of 'at', a T, and attach it.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective it describes something tiny, far below normal size.

clue.text: He's very strict about a tent-rim

indicators.note: signals that the letters of the following words are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: A stern person fussing over the edge of a tent.
explanation.walkthrough: A plus TENTRIM, eight letters, rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigid disciplinarian who insists on rules being obeyed to the letter, named after a French drillmaster.

clue.text: Goes overseas for felonious purposes

parts.note: a sea robber travels by ship to commit crimes of plunder

explanation.surface: Someone travels abroad to commit crimes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Overseas' reads as abroad, but it means literally over the seas, robbing ships.
explanation.definitionFit: A buccaneer sails the oceans in order to rob vessels, a criminal purpose.

clue.text: Shown again? Rapped over the knuckles, rather!

definitions.meaning: demonstrated a second time
an idiom for being told off or rebuked

explanation.surface: Someone was demonstrated wrong again and rebuked into the bargain.
explanation.definitionFit: Read whole it means scolded or censured; split it means demonstrated once more.

clue.text: Need one queer new shape to start right

indicators.note: the right-hand letter is placed at the beginning of the answer
the letters of the words are given a fresh shape, an arrangement

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A demand that something odd be reshaped beginning on the correct side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queer' reads as an adjective on 'new shape', but it is anagram fodder; 'to start' places the right-hand letter at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: To require something is to have a need for it, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Weakened her lover by behaving cuttingly

definitions.text: Weakened her lover by behaving cuttingly

parts.words: Weakened her lover by behaving cuttingly
parts.note: the Biblical temptress had Samson's hair cut, robbing him of his strength

explanation.surface: A woman whose sharp tongue drained her partner's spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cuttingly' suggests sarcasm, but it is literal: the Philistine woman had Samson's locks shorn.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Book of Judges she betrayed Samson by having his hair cut, the source of his strength.

clue.text: Their station in life tends to put a damper on things!

definitions.text: Their station in life tends to put a damper on things!

parts.words: Their station in life tends to put a damper on things!
parts.note: fire crews work from a station and douse blazes with water

explanation.surface: A grumble about people whose social position makes them killjoys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Station in life' means social rank, but here it is the building fire crews work from, and 'damper' is literal wetting.
explanation.definitionFit: Firefighters are based at a station and spray water on burning things.

clue.text: Pole in the bag doesn't provide much food

indicators.note: the pole letter is placed inside the bag

parts.note: a sack is a large bag

explanation.surface: A Polish person's packed lunch is meagre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person, but it is a compass pole, N for north.
explanation.definitionFit: A light bite between meals is a small amount of eating, never a full meal.

clue.text: Resort to illuminate, we hear

indicators.note: signals the word is judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: to brighten is to light up

explanation.surface: A seaside town is meant to cast light, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: BRIGHTON is a seaside resort town on England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a well-known English seaside holiday town on the Sussex coast.

clue.text: Put pressure on with this weapon

definitions.text: Put pressure on with this weapon

parts.words: Put pressure on with this weapon
parts.note: a gun firing pellets by compressed air pressure

explanation.surface: Advice to coerce someone at gunpoint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put pressure on' sounds like coercion, but it is literal: the gun is powered by pressurised air.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle or pistol that uses compressed air rather than gunpowder to fire pellets.

clue.text: Keep an ear open. It's silent — that's strange

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of the word are oddly reordered

explanation.surface: A reminder to pay attention, noting that the quiet is odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying attention with your hearing is what keeping an ear open means.

clue.text: They sunder, but suggest things that stick together!

definitions.meaning: chopping tools that split things apart
the old verb cleave also means cling, and the plant goosegrass sticks to clothes

explanation.surface: Things that split apart but hint at clinging.
explanation.definitionFit: Butchers' choppers split meat, yet cleave also means to adhere, and goosegrass is a clinging weed.

clue.text: Punishes — at a drumhead court-martial, perhaps?

definitions.meaning: strikes repeatedly as a punishment
strokes struck on a drumhead, rhythmic drum sounds

explanation.surface: Someone is punished at a battlefield military trial.
explanation.walkthrough: A drumhead court-martial is a summary trial held in the field, but 'drumhead' is the skin a drummer strikes.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrashes as punishment; also the rhythmic strokes heard on a drum skin.

clue.text: Which lays in the garden?

parts.note: a playful picture of a plant that produces eggs, the aubergine

explanation.surface: A question about what lays eggs among the flowerbeds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lays' suggests a hen, but the answer is a vegetable whose name implies egg-laying.
explanation.definitionFit: The aubergine, called this in American English, is a garden vegetable.

clue.text: Sin for a large feline group

definitions.meaning: one of the seven deadly sins, arrogance
the collective noun for a group of lions

explanation.surface: A naughty act committed for the sake of a group of big cats.
explanation.definitionFit: Excess self-esteem is a deadly sin; also the collective name for a group of lions.

clue.text: Hears calls over the waves in an unprofessional way

definitions.text: Hears calls over the waves in an unprofessional way

parts.words: Hears calls over the waves in an unprofessional way
parts.note: an amateur radio enthusiast picks up signals sent on airwaves

explanation.surface: Someone at sea receives messages carelessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Waves' suggests the sea, but means radio waves; 'unprofessional' means amateur, not sloppy.
explanation.definitionFit: An amateur radio operator who sends and receives transmissions as a hobby.

clue.text: Not hobbyists frequently interested in models

definitions.text: Not hobbyists frequently interested in models

parts.words: Not hobbyists frequently interested in models
parts.note: painters and sculptors often work from life models, unlike model-kit builders

explanation.surface: People keen on models who are not mere hobby enthusiasts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Models' suggests model kits for hobbyists, but means people who sit for painters.
explanation.definitionFit: Painters and sculptors often work from human sitters posing for them.

clue.text: Oblique remark looks as if it refers to a team!

definitions.meaning: a comment spoken in passing, as on stage to the audience

definitions.text: looks as if it refers to a team
definitions.meaning: read as two words it says a side, a team

explanation.surface: An indirect comment that seems to be about a sports squad.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor's remark to the audience, unheard by others on stage; split, it reads as a team.

clue.text: Being landed, paid up

definitions.meaning: having ... on land, colonised
a bill that has been cleared

explanation.surface: Someone has arrived ashore and cleared their debts.
explanation.definitionFit: Colonised or established in a place; also describes a debt cleared in full.

clue.text: Go on a state trip

definitions.meaning: move forward, advance
a ceremonial tour by a monarch

explanation.surface: An instruction to take an official journey.
explanation.definitionFit: To advance or proceed; historically also a royal tour through the realm.

clue.text: Such watery phenomena can give one quite a turn!

definitions.text: Such watery phenomena can give one quite a turn!

parts.words: Such watery phenomena can give one quite a turn!
parts.note: whirlpool currents spin a swimmer round

explanation.surface: Water features that can frighten someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give one quite a turn' means give a fright, but here it is literal spinning.
explanation.definitionFit: Small whirling currents in water spin objects round.

clue.text: Got down quickly, being forced under the surface

definitions.meaning: dodged by crouching fast
dunked underwater

explanation.surface: Someone dropped quickly as they were pushed underwater.
explanation.definitionFit: To dodge by bobbing down; also to be plunged under water.

clue.text: Reactionary wants them replaced? Put back, anyway

definitions.text: Reactionary wants them replaced? Put back, anyway

parts.words: Reactionary wants them replaced? Put back, anyway
parts.note: a reactionary wants to turn back time; timepieces are put back when summer time ends

explanation.surface: A conservative wants things restored, or at least returned.
explanation.walkthrough: A reactionary wants to 'put the clock back'; in autumn timepieces really are put back an hour.
explanation.definitionFit: Timepieces, which are set back an hour when daylight saving ends.

clue.text: Muck's brass, they say? Well, our money certainly is ground!

definitions.text: Muck's brass, they say? Well, our money certainly is ground!

parts.words: Muck's brass, they say? Well, our money certainly is ground!
parts.note: coins have ridged edges, and ground grain is processed in a mill

explanation.surface: A riff on the saying that there is money in dirt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Where there's muck there's brass' is a northern English saying: dirty work pays. Coins have ridged edges, and 'ground' also means pulverised.
explanation.definitionFit: Coins with ridged edges are described this way; it also means ground in a mill.

clue.text: Very unsocial sky-divers, it would seem

definitions.text: Very unsocial sky-divers, it would seem

parts.words: Very unsocial sky-divers, it would seem
parts.note: parachutists literally fall out of planes; the word also means people who reject society

explanation.surface: Parachutists who seem antisocial.
explanation.definitionFit: People who withdraw from conventional society; literally, those who fall from aircraft.

clue.text: Like 2 down, the stand-in often has in the pictures

definitions.meaning: the answer to 2 down means undersized

definitions.text: the stand-in often has in the pictures
definitions.meaning: a stunt double has performed dangerous feats in films

explanation.surface: A film double's work described as undersized.
explanation.definitionFit: Means held back in growth, small; split as stunt-ed it is what a film double has done.

clue.text: They rise in rage and cut the French

explanation.surface: Angry feelings that make someone slash at the French.
explanation.walkthrough: The neck feathers or hairs on an animal's back stand up when it is angry.
explanation.definitionFit: Feathers or hairs on a neck that bristle when an animal is roused to anger.
